testerDefaults.note: When useGate=true: registered on first allowed gate check. When useGate=false: auto-registered when ?t=<name> is used (name must match ^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$)

referralDefaults.note: Auto-registered when someone clicks ?r=<tester> link (referrer validated via gate when useGate=true)

notes.useGate: When true, validates invite codes via Keystone gate API. When false, uses legacy auto-register mode. Deploying this changes nothing until you set useGate=true.
notes.owner: For unlimited access, add your invite code to testers with limit:0. Example: { "your-invite-code": { "limit": 0, "days": 0 } }
